summary: Rules-expert agents write one harness-based unit test file per card (one test per rules clause); engine bugs recorded as test.failing("BUG: ...").

bugs.bug: BUG: 'Units you play this turn enter ready' — a unit played after Confront resolves enters ready (143.4 / 369.3)
BUG: 'up to two' — two other friendly units can be chosen and both get buffed
BUG: 'up to two' — choosing no unit at all is allowed
BUG: targets only units AT A BATTLEFIELD — a unit in a base is never a legal choice
BUG: can return a friendly FACEDOWN card to its owner's hand
BUG: 'open' means uncontrolled AND unoccupied (170.11.c) — an uncontrolled battlefield with an enemy unit on it is not offered
BUG: playing her to an open battlefield contests it and, after the showdown, you control it and score (190.3.a.1, 344.2, 190.4)
BUG: the third move in a turn scores exactly 1 point
BUG: only the THIRD move — a fourth move in the same turn does not score again (total stays 1)
BUG: targets only a FRIENDLY unit IN YOUR BASE — units at battlefields and enemy units are not offered
BUG: 'then move it to a battlefield' — after the buff the unit is moved to a battlefield of your choice
BUG: moving it into an enemy-held battlefield contests it — combat follows and the buffed 3-Might unit beats a 2-Might defender
BUG: killing the lone defender during the combat showdown leaves the attacker to win and conquer (466.1.a.2, 466.3.a, 466.5)
BUG: killing the lone 1-Might defender with the trigger should leave Corsair at bf1 and conquer it (rules 465.1, 466.3.a, 466.5)
BUG: readying an exhausted friendly unit gives THAT UNIT +1 Might this turn only
BUG: Awaken Phase readying (rule 415.3.a) is 'you ready' — exhausted friendly units should get +1 Might on your new turn
BUG: the spell Gust answered then fizzles — a unit bounced to hand is no longer a legal target (rule 359.3.e.5)
BUG: 'When this is played … draw 1' — playing it puts a trigger on the chain and draws 1
BUG: 'When this is … discarded … draw 1' — discarded from hand by your own effect draws 1
BUG: 'When this is … killed, draw 1' — killed on the board (even by an opponent's spell) its controller draws 1
BUG: looking at Nocturne on top of your deck (Vision) offers 'you may banish me', then 'play me for [rainbow]'
BUG: TWO friendly units are chosen and each gets +2 Might
BUG: the enemy unit must be at the SAME battlefield as the friendly one (units in base / other battlefields are not legal)
BUG: stunned units deal no combat damage this turn — the following combat leaves both undamaged (rule 423.1.b)
BUG: ALL friendly units (base and battlefields) get +5 — nothing is targeted, castable even with no units
BUG: while the attacker still holds Focus the defender may not play an Action spell (rules 313.1, 347)
BUG: non-Recruit only — a Recruit token dying creates nothing (rule 187.1: the token has the Recruit tag)
BUG: a friendly unit dying IN COMBAT also triggers Viktor (any death counts)
BUG: 'before scoring' — a battlefield held only by a Sprite does not score its controller a Hold point (rules 816.1.b, 190.4.c)

BUG: costs [2] less (2 energy + body) once an enemy unit has died this turn

BUG: mode 'Ready me' readies an exhausted Udyr
BUG: 'not chosen this turn' — after picking Ganking, a re-buffed Udyr is offered only the other three modes
BUG: costs 2 energy; returns the chosen unit from your trash to your hand; spell goes to trash
BUG: only UNIT cards in YOUR TRASH are eligible — not spells, not the opponent's trash, not units on the board
BUG: a unit on the board can never be 'returned' by Morbid Return
BUG: optional additional cost — spending a friendly buff makes the spell free (0 energy paid, donor loses its buff)
BUG: moving to an open battlefield plays a 1-Might Recruit unit token at that battlefield
BUG: the Recruit token is played, so it enters exhausted (rule 143.4)
BUG: moving into an enemy-held battlefield also makes a Recruit there (before combat resolves)

BUG: your ABILITIES deal 1 Bonus Damage — Iron Ballista's 'Deal 2' deals 3

BUG: '(You must still pay its Power cost.)' — bringing back Vi (2 + [fury]) spends the fury but no energy
BUG: Assault — while attacking its current Might reads 3 (807.1.c, cf. 432.1.a)

BUG: the stun wears off at end of turn (423.1.a.2)
BUG: 'all units at battlefields' is not a choice (355.5.a) — the trigger resolves without any target prompt
BUG: deals 3 to EVERY unit at every battlefield (enemy and friendly); units in bases take nothing

BUG: may be played to an OCCUPIED ENEMY battlefield; combat then begins there (355.2.b, 323.13) — only base/own battlefields are offered
BUG: 'open' means unoccupied AND uncontrolled (170.11.c) — an uncontrolled battlefield holding an enemy unit is still offered as a play location
